Post 1

Tech surged 2.67% while Utilities cratered 2.03% — same session, opposite outcomes. ASX 200 added 25.90pts to 8,757.80 (+0.30%). Rotation is the story, not the headline number. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

📈 IT +2.67%, Consumer Discretionary +1.29% led the charge. 🔻 Utilities -2.03%, Energy -1.16% dragged. Growth over defensives — the market is making a clear bet on risk appetite right now. #ASX #energy #ausbiz

Post 3

🔺 SRL surged 12.71% to AUD 20.48 — Sunrise Energy Metals was the session's sharpest single move in the ASX 200. When a metals junior moves that hard, the market is pricing in a catalyst. Watch volume. #ASX #mining

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD 6,126.38/oz. Silver AUD 92.51/oz. With Materials up 0.58% today, precious metals are providing a floor. AUD/USD sits at 0.7117 — a key input for every commodity price local investors see. #gold #silver #commodities #ASX

Post 5

ASX is up 0.98% over five days but flat year-to-date — the index is treading water at 8,757.80. Can IT momentum hold, or does Energy drag resurface? Where do you see the index by Friday? #ASX #ausbiz #investing
